items.title: STERIS agrees to buy Xodus Medical (Pink Pad patient positioning) for $2.1bn
items.summary: STERIS agreed to acquire Xodus Medical for $2.1bn cash at closing (about $1.8bn net of tax benefits), plus an earnout of up to $150m tied to 2028 targets. Xodus expects about $245m revenue in 2026. Closing expected by 31 December 2026, subject to regulatory approvals.

items.title: Get involved in World AMR Awareness Week 2026
items.summary: World AMR Awareness Week takes place from 18–24 November, and this year IPS is putting infection prevention at the heart of the conversation. Every day, infection prevention actions help prevent infections, reduce the need for` antimicrobials and help tackle antimicrobial resistance (AMR).

items.title: Strategy to achieve hospital-acquired pressure ulcer improvement and an effective incident learning response
items.summary: Background: Preventing hospital-acquired pressure ulcers (HAPUs) remains a high priority safety concern on local and national agendas. Rigorous action plans and improvement strategies are central to reducing the incidence of PUs, which are largely preventable.

items.title: Infection prevention and control in managed communal accommodation settings
items.summary: Effective infection prevention and control helps protect the health and wellbeing of people in communal accommodation settings.

items.title: From Cluj with friendship: reflections from APCI-IFIC 2026
items.summary: IPS President Kerry Holden reflects on representing the Infection Prevention Society at the APCI Conference on Infection Prevention and Control in Cluj-Napoca, Romania, held in collaboration with the International Federation of Infection Control (IFIC).

items.title: Martin Kiernan Awarded Honorary Membership of the Infection Prevention Society
items.summary: The Infection Prevention Society (IPS) is delighted to announce that Martin Kiernan has been awarded Honorary Membership in recognition of his outstanding contribution to infection prevention and control (IPC), his leadership within the profession, and his longstanding service to the Society.

items.title: Celebrating Ben Degay: IPS Rising Star in IPC 2026
items.summary: The Infection Prevention Society (IPS) is delighted to celebrate Ben Degay, winner of the Rising Star in IPC Award 2026, presented at Infection Prevention 2026 in Leeds.

items.title: Newcastle upon Tyne Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust recognised for exceptional contribution to research and quality improvement
items.summary: Newcastle upon Tyne Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust has been named winner of the Exceptional Contribution to Research or Quality Improvement Award at the IPS Impact Awards 2026 for its innovative project, Interrupting CPE Transmission in Critical Care through a Multidisciplinary Water-Lite Strategy.

Celebrating the UK Public Health Rapid Support Team: Team of the Year 2026
items.summary: The UK Public Health Rapid Support Team Infection Prevention and Control (UKPHRST IPC) team took home the Team of the Year Award 2026 at this year’s IPS Impact Awards.

items.title: Infection prevention and control (IPC) in adult social care (ASC)
items.summary: Guidance for all ASC settings, including care homes, supported living, day services and domiciliary care.

items.title: IPS endorses new IPC Environmental Sustainability Statement
items.summary: We’re pleased to endorse the new Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) Environmental Sustainability Statement, developed and endorsed by the Department of Health and Social Care, NHS England and organisations across the health and care sector.

items.title: Early Career professionals share real experiences and learning
items.summary: For Infection Prevention Week 2026, we’re highlighting the experiences and practical lessons shaping the next generation of infection prevention and control (IPC) professionals.

items.title: Infection Prevention Week Spotlight: The CLEAN Campaign’s Lasting Impact
items.summary: Every day, infection prevention and control professionals work behind the scenes to protect patients, reduce harm and support safe healthcare delivery.

items.title: Honouring the pioneers who shaped infection prevention
items.summary: As Infection Prevention Week begins, we are reflecting on the pioneers whose work laid the foundations of modern infection prevention and control, while recognising the professionals who continue to advance the specialty today. Infection prevention saves lives.

items.title: Celebrating Michael Mark Dalauidao: IPS Infection Prevention and Control Practitioner of the Year 2026
items.summary: Huge congratulations to Michael Mark Dalauidao, recipient of the Infection Prevention and Control Practitioner of the Year Award 2026, presented at IP2026 in Leeds.
